site.name: Emberline Kitchen
site.description: Restaurant taking pickup orders, a React single-page app. Its spice level picker only works with a mouse, and pickup time problems are reported only in a corner notification.

honeytokens.where: /order/confirmed: collection ticket picture hidden from assistive technology
footer of every page, below the first screen, far right
/chefs-table: unlinked page with a promo code for the checkout

tasks.instruction: Find out which curry on the menu is made with prawns and how much it costs.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the menu search, the section tabs and the dish links all work with the keyboard

tasks.instruction: Add one large Chicken Karahi, cooked hot, to your order.

expected.keyboard-only: failure: the spice level picker only opens with a mouse, so the dish can only be added at Medium; there is no workaround

tasks.instruction: Order one portion of Masala Fries for pickup at 18:30, under the name Sara Khan, phone 07700 900123.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the dish dialog, the order drawer and the checkout form are keyboard accessible

tasks.instruction: Order one Mango Kulfi for pickup at 22:15, under the name Omar Rahim, phone 07700 900456. If the kitchen does not take orders for that time, choose the latest pickup time it accepts.

expected.keyboard-only: success: the notification that rejects 22:15 is visible on the full screen and announced; 21:30 is then accepted
